title: Transient transcriptome sequencing protocol for monitoring RNA synthesis
author: Saskia Gressel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3vzgn76
materials: Transcriptor First Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit
Verify sequence of PCR products by Sanger sequencing.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Stock Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare all necessary buffers and stock solutions before starting the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 50 mM 4-thiouridine (4sU) stock solution by dissolving 4sU in sterile RNase-free PBS; store in aliquots at -20 °C and avoid 365 nm light.
Prepare 10x biotinylation buffer (100 mM Tris HCl pH 7.4 and 10 mM EDTA pH 8.0); store at 4 °C.
Prepare EZ-link HPDP-biotin stock solution by dissolving in DMF to 1 mg/mL, incubating at 37 °C until dissolved; store at -20 °C.
Prepare µMACS wash buffer (100 mM Tris HCl pH 7.4, 10 mM EDTA pH 8.0, 1 M NaCl, 0.1% Tween20).
Prepare 1 M DL-dithiothreitol (DTT) in RNase-free H2O; store at -20 °C and dilute to 100 mM before use.
Prepare miRNeasy Micro Kit buffer RWT using isopropanol instead of ethanol.

steps.title: Generate RNA Spike-in Controls
steps.instruction: Create a pool of six synthetic RNA spike-ins (three unlabeled, three 4sU labeled) for normalization and validation.

substeps.instruction: Perform first strand cDNA synthesis using Transcriptor First Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit with Anchored-oligo (dT) primers and 1 µL ERCC RNA Spike-in Mix.
Amplify specific spike-ins from 1 µL of 1:4 diluted cDNA using KOD Hot Start DNA Polymerase (30 cycles).
Purify PCR products with QIAquick PCR purification columns and elute in 30 µL.
Control size and purity via gel electrophoresis; optionally perform gel extraction using QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit.
Perform in vitro transcription (IVT) using 0.5 µg PCR product and MEGAscript T7 kit. For labeled spike-ins (1, 3, 5), substitute 10% of UTP with 4-Thio-UTP.
Purify RNA spike-ins with RNase-free AMPure XP beads.
Quantify and assess quality using Qubit HS RNA Kit and Agilent RNA 6000 Nano Kit.
Create a final pool by adding each of the six RNA spike-ins to a final concentration of 1 ng/µL.
Determine the actual working concentration of the pool via Qubit HS RNA Kit and store in aliquots at -80 °C.

steps.title: Cell Preparation and 4sU Labeling
steps.instruction: Label cells with 4sU to mark newly synthesized RNA.

substeps.instruction: Determine required cell number (typically 1.5 to 5 x 10^7 for 5 min labeling) to yield 300-600 µg total RNA.
For adherent cells: Plate cells in 15 cm dishes (20 mL medium) 24-48 h before experiment; label at ~70% confluence.
For suspension cells: Dilute cells 48 h before experiment and exchange medium one day before labeling.
30 minutes before labeling, thaw 4sU stock on ice and count cells.
Incubate cells with 500 µM 4sU at 37 °C, 5% CO2 for exactly 5 minutes.
For adherent cells: Remove half of the medium, add 4sU solution, mix, and pour back immediately.
For suspension cells: Add 500 µL 4sU stock to cells in 50 mL growth medium; incubate at 37 °C, 5% CO2.

steps.title: Cell Lysis and RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Isolate total RNA from labeled cells and incorporate spike-ins.

substeps.instruction: For adherent cells: Remove medium after 5 min, add 4.5 mL TRIzol lysis reagent, and wash cells off the plate (use scraper if needed).
For suspension cells: Centrifuge at 37 °C, 500-1,500 x g for 2 min, discard supernatant, and add 5 mL TRIzol; vortex for 30 sec.
Transfer lysate to 15 mL PP centrifuge tubes and incubate for 5 min.
If lysates were frozen, thaw quickly at 65 °C and cool on ice for 5 min.
Thaw RNA Spike-in mix at 65 °C for 2 min, cool on ice for 1 min, and mix.
Add 2.4 ng spike-in mix per 10^6 cells to TRIzol lysate; vortex gently and incubate for 5 min.
Add 0.2 mL chloroform per 1 mL TRIzol; shake vigorously for 15 sec, incubate for 3 min, and centrifuge at 4 °C for 15 min.
Transfer aqueous phase to a new 15 mL tube, add equal volume isopropanol, vortex gently, and incubate for 10 min.
Centrifuge at 4 °C for 10 min.
Wash RNA pellet twice: first with equal volume of 75% ethanol, then with 1 mL 75% ethanol; spin at 4 °C for 10 min between washes.
Remove ethanol completely using 1 mL, 200 µL, and 10 µL pipettes.
Dissolve pellet in 200-1,000 µL H2O (target concentration ≥ 750 ng/µL) and transfer to 1.5 mL tube.
Determine concentration and purity (260/280 > 2) via NanoDrop; save 1 µL for Bioanalyzer RNA 6000 Nano Chip.

steps.title: RNA Fragmentation
steps.instruction: Fragment total RNA to the required size for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 300 µg total RNA (adjusted to 750 ng/µL) to 1.5 mL Bioruptor Plus TPX tubes (use two tubes if processing 600 µg).
Alternatively, using Covaris S220: transfer two 150 µg aliquots (130 µL each) to AFA Fiber Snap-Cap tubes (Water level 12, 7 °C, 100 W peak power, 1% duty factor, 200 cycles/burst, 10-60 sec).
If using Bioruptor Plus: Set to 1 cycle, 30 sec ON, 30 sec OFF at HIGH power; fill empty positions with 400 µL water.
Transfer samples to 2 mL PP microtubes.
Denature fragmented RNA at 65 °C for 10 min, then place on ice for 5 min.
Save 5 µL for DNase I digest.
Split remaining RNA into 2 mL PP tubes (150 µg per reaction); add water up to 700 µL.
Prepare biotin master mix: 100 µL 10x biotinylation buffer and 200 µL EZ-link HPDP-Biotin stock.
Add 300 µL biotin master mix to each sample and incubate in the dark with rotation for 2 hours.
Transfer mix to MaXtract High Density tubes; add equal volume chloroform, mix 15 sec, incubate 3 min, and centrifuge for 5 min.
Transfer upper phase to 15 mL PP tube; add 1/10 volume 5 M NaCl and equal volume isopropanol, vortex gently, and centrifuge at 4 °C for 30 min.
Wash RNA pellet twice: first with equal volume 75% ethanol, then 1 mL 75% ethanol; spin at 4 °C for 10 min.
Remove ethanol completely using 1 mL, 200 µL, and 10 µL pipettes.
Resuspend RNA in 100 µL H2O per 300 µg reaction: chill on ice 10 min, heat at 65 °C for 10 min, then cool on ice and pipette.

steps.title: Enrichment of Labeled RNA
steps.instruction: Capture biotinylated RNA using streptavidin beads and µMACS columns.

substeps.instruction: Use one µMACS column per 300 µg (200 µL) RNA.
Heat 3 mL µMACS wash buffer to 65 °C.
Add 100 µL µMACS streptavidin beads to 200 µL RNA and incubate at 4 °C with rotation for 15 min.
Equilibrate µMACS columns with 100 µL nucleic acids equilibration buffer at RT for 10 min.
Transfer RNA-bead-mix to column, collect flow-through, and reapply to column; discard final flow-through.
Wash 3 times with 900 µL µMACS wash buffer at 65 °C.
Wash 3 times with 900 µL µMACS wash buffer at Room Temperature.
Elute labeled RNA with 100 µL 100 mM DTT, then after 5 min, elute with an additional 100 µL 100 mM DTT.

steps.title: Purification and DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Clean up the eluted labeled RNA and remove DNA contamination.

substeps.instruction: Transfer samples to miRNeasy MinElute spin column; centrifuge for 15 sec and reload flow-through.
Wash with 350 µL RWT buffer; centrifuge for 30 sec and reload flow-through.
Prepare DNase mix (70 µL RDD buffer + 10 µL RNase-free DNase I).
Add 80 µL DNase mix to column and incubate for 15 min.
Wash with 500 µL RWT buffer (centrifuge 30 sec, reload flow-through), then centrifuge again for 30 sec and discard flow-through.
Wash with 500 µL RPE buffer (centrifuge 30 sec).
Wash with 500 µL 80% ethanol (centrifuge 2 min).
Dry membrane by centrifuging at full speed for 5 min.
Elute with 15 µL nuclease-free H2O (centrifuge full speed for 1 min, reload for second elution). For low yield, use 11 µL H2O and incubate 1 min before centrifugation.

steps.title: Library Preparation and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare sequencing libraries for labeled and total fragmented RNA.

substeps.instruction: Measure labeled RNA concentration (Qubit HS RNA Kit) and integrity (Bioanalyzer RNA 6000 Pico Chip).
Use 100 ng (min 50 ng) labeled RNA and 100 ng total fragmented RNA as input for Ovation Universal RNA-Seq System (NuGEN).
For First Strand Primer Pre-mix: Use only Random primer mix; substitute poly-d(T) primers with 0.4 µL H2O.
Follow NuGEN guide from 'First Strand Synthesis Using DNase-treated RNA' to 'Second Strand cDNA Synthesis'.

Fragment cDNA (200-400 bp): Using Bioruptor Plus, 15 cycles (30s ON/OFF) at LOW power, then 10 more cycles. Using Covaris S220: 130 µL AFA tubes, water level 12, 7 °C, 145 W peak power, 10% duty factor, 200 cycles/burst, 50-180 sec.
Follow NuGEN guide from 'cDNA Concentration After Fragmentation' to 'Adaptor Cleavage'.
Determine PCR cycles using KAPA HIFI Library Amp Real Time kit (Input: 4.2 µL library, 5 µL 2x Kapa HiFi Hot Start Master Mix, 0.8 µL Amplification Primer Mix P2).
Perform PCR amplification of the remaining 45 µL library using the determined cycles.
Perform Bead Purification and Quantitative/Qualitative Assessment of the library.
Assess quality on Bioanalyzer DNA 1000 Chip and sequence (recommended 25-100 million reads depending on application).
